name: litigation-legal
description: Matter intake, chronology building, privilege review, deposition preparation, brief drafting, and claim charting for litigators and their teams.
author: Anthropic

skills.name: cold-start-interview
skills.description: Initial practice profile setup — learns your practice area, court mix, and matter management preferences in 10-15 minutes

skills.name: matter-intake
skills.description: Structure a new matter — conflicts check inputs, key parties, claims, defenses, statute of limitations, and initial discovery needs

skills.name: chronology
skills.description: Build a structured factual chronology from uploaded documents, deposition transcripts, and discovery materials

skills.name: privilege-review
skills.description: Screen a document set for attorney-client privilege and work product protection; generate a privilege log

skills.name: deposition-prep
skills.description: Generate a deposition outline with key topics, factual anchors, and impeachment hooks keyed to a specific witness

skills.name: brief-draft
skills.description: Draft or review a brief section — statement of facts, argument headings, or a specific legal argument with cited authority

skills.name: claim-chart
skills.description: Map legal claims or patent claims to factual record in a structured chart for trial or arbitration preparation
